head: 93aade75946b7e9b738464008f4ae8ef651b14fb
title: refactor(api): use Agent.make, native model provision, and typed inputs
description:
Agent execution currently requires a Binding and accepts `unknown` input, so malformed typed inputs compile and composed model Layers cannot be supplied through the normal Effect boundary. Rename `Agent.define` to `Agent.make`, let execution accept Definitions, and require the native LanguageModel and model identity services in `R`.

The execution call site changes from:

```ts
AgentRuntime.run(Agent.withModel(Planner, model), input);
```

to:

```ts
AgentRuntime.run(Planner, input).pipe(Effect.provide(model));
```

Native model Layers, ordinary Layer composition, and `model.captureRequirements` work without rebuilding a Model. Keep `withModel` for durable registration and Subagent construction, where each Agent needs an explicit model choice; it now accepts Layers providing all three native model services. Bindings remain executable, and their model resources close before retained history commits or completion becomes visible, including detached execution. Models provided by an enclosing application Layer retain that application's Scope.

`run`, `stream`, and `start` accept the input Schema's **Encoded** representation and retain runtime decoding. Instructions receive the decoded **Type**. External `unknown` data uses `runUnknown`, `streamUnknown`, or `startUnknown`; an unrestricted overload on the primary operations would defeat input checking. Transforming Schemas retain their decoding and encoding services in `R`. Union-typed Definitions and Bindings retain every branch's Tool handlers, Schema services, and declared failures, including when one branch has no Tools.

Update consumers, introductory guides, the changeset, and committed Action bundles. Type proofs cover inferred failures and requirements, malformed inputs, and durable Layer registration. Runtime regressions cover input transformations, rejection before instructions/model calls, and captured model resource lifetime.

Validation: `vp run ready` passed. Opt-in live-provider cases were skipped.

Implements [KOM-11](https://linear.app/reve-ai/issue/KOM-11). The introductory examples preserve the alpha guidance from [KOM-10](https://linear.app/reve-ai/issue/KOM-10).
